params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Riven}} {{tip|ability}} casts generate {{tip|stacks}} of ''Charge'', which stacks up to a cap. '''Riven's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} consume a stack to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Riven's''' {{tip|ability}} casts generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Charge'' for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 3 times. '''Riven's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-attack}} are empowered to each consume a stack {{tip|on-hit}} to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|30 + (45-30)/17*(x-1) for 20}} AD}}, reduced to{{ft|50%|{{as|{{pp|key=%|(30 + (45-30)/17*(x-1))*0.5 for 20|formula=50% of non-structure damage}} AD}}}}against {{tip|structures}}. Against {{tip|monsters}}, it also deals {{as|50 '''additional bonus''' physical damage|physical damage}}.
params.description2: The '''bonus''' damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers and {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 100% effectiveness.
params.notes: * ''Runic Blade's'' duration also refreshes when '''Riven''' consumes a stack. * The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|wards}}. * The number of empowered attacks available is represented by a counter under her [[health bar]], only visible to the player. * The bonus damage to monsters also benefits from critical strike modifiers. The full formula is shown below. ** ({{fd|1.0}} AD{{times}}(1 + AD ratio) + monster damage){{times}}(100%{{times}}critical damage)

params.blurb:
{{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Riven}} can cast this ability up to three times in quick succession, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
* {{sbc|First Cast:}} '''Riven''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} forward and slashes her sword in a circle.
* {{sbc|Second Cast:}} '''Riven''' mimics the first cast.
* {{sbc|Third Cast:}} '''Riven''' mimics the first cast's dash, but now slams her sword in a larger circle, briefly {{tip|airborne|knocking back}} enemies hit as well.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Riven''' can activate ''Broken Wings'' three times before the ability goes on cooldown, with a {{fd|0.3125}}-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} between casts. If '''Riven''' does not recast the ability within 4 seconds of the previous cast, it goes on cooldown.
params.description2: '''Riven''' slashes with her sword for each of the three casts, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies struck within an area, {{tip|Basic attack reset|resetting}} her basic attack timer, and ordering her to basic attack the target of ''Broken Wings'' if there are any.
params.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|45 to 165}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60 to 80}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|45*3 to 165*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60*3 to 80*3}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
params.description3: {{sbc|First Cast:}} '''Riven''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} 225 units in the direction she is currently facing, or up to 225 units towards the target enemy, striking enemies in the target area 100 units away. This cast cannot cross terrain.
params.description4: {{sbc|Second Cast:}} '''Riven''' mimics the first cast's effects.
params.description5: {{sbc|Third Cast:}} '''Riven''' mimics the first cast's effects in a larger area while also {{tip|airborne|knocking back}} enemies hit 75 units over {{fd|0.5}} seconds. This cast can cross terrain.
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tt|{{fd|150}}|First/second cast standard radius}}|{{tt|250|Third cast standard radius}}|{{tt|200|First/second cast enhanced radius during Blade of the Exile}}|{{tt|300|Third cast enhanced radius during Blade of the Exile}}}}
params.outofrange: The ability will cast in the direction of the targeted enemy regardless of range
params.notes:
{{always quickcast}}
* Each cast counts as a single ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* Moving after using ''Broken Wings'' allows Riven to do other actions faster.
* The {{sbc|Third Cast}} prevents '''Riven''' from using basic attacks and abilities for longer than the other 2 casts.
* The {{sbc|Third Cast}} may have an extended dash range when crossing terrain.
* The {{sbc|Third Cast's}} {{tip|airborne|knockup}} debuff is not removed early if the forced movement is interrupted.
* Any forced movement affecting the target being knocked up is {{tip|knockdown|interrupted}} when the {{tip|airborne|knockup}} debuff is removed.{{bug|2|this is not the case for most other knockups}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Riven}} emits a flash of runic energy, dealing {{as|physical damage}} and briefly {{tip|stun|stunning}} nearby enemies.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Riven''' emits a flash of runic energy, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|300|Standard radius}}|{{tt|360|Enhanced radius during Blade of the Exile}}}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Riven}} {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction and gains a brief {{tip|shield}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Riven''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction, though not through terrain, while granting herself a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
params.description2: '''''Riven''' can cast any of her abilities during the dash. Valor will cast at max range if cast beyond that.''
params.notes:
{{always quickcast}}
* {{ai|Q|Riven}} may be cast during {{ai|W|Riven}} or {{ai|R|Riven}} cast times if they're used at the end or briefly after the dash.{{bug|1}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Riven}} empowers her blade for some time, gaining {{sti|ad|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and increased {{sti|range}} on her {{tip|basic attacks}}, ''{{ai|Broken Wings|Riven}}'' and ''{{ai|Ki Burst|Riven}}''.
params.blurb2: During this time, '''Riven''' can cast ''{{ai|Wind Slash|Riven}}''.
params.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Riven''' empowers her blade for 15 seconds, gaining {{as|20% AD}} {{sti|ad|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}, {{sti|range|75 '''bonus''' attack range}}, and increased range on ''{{ai|Broken Wings|Riven}}'' and ''{{ai|Ki Burst|Riven}}''.

After {{fd|0.5}} seconds, she can cast ''{{ai|Wind Slash|Riven}}'' within the duration.
params.notes:
* All bonuses are gained after {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the ability starting its cast.
** The {{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}} amount is factored upon cast, and does not change.
* If '''Riven''' has a basic attack buffered before the end of ''Blade of the Exile's'' cast time, the buffered basic attack will start {{fd|0.33}} seconds after the end of the cast time.
** The delay will not apply to basic attack commands input after ''Blade of the Exile's'' cast time.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Riven}} unleashes a wave of energy in a cone in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit based on {{as|their '''missing''' health}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Riven''' unleashes a wave of energy in a cone in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased by {{as|{{pp|type= target's '''missing''' health|key=%|0 to 200 for 9|key1=%|0 to 75|formula=2.667% per 1% missing health. ''This is capped at 200% bonus damage at 75% missing health.''}}|health}}.
params.leveling: {{st|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|100 to 200}} {{as|(+ 55% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Maximum Physical Damage|{{ap|100*3 to 200*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|55*3}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
params.angle: {{tt|18{{degree}}|Right and left missiles at 9° to their side, respectively (see notes)}}
params.notes:
* ''Wind Slash'' counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* The ability will cast to wherever the caster's cursor was at the start of cast time.
* ''Wind Slash's'' wave is made up of three individual missiles spread in a cone.
** Each enemy can be damaged by only one missile.<!--Marker buff duration?-->
* If ''Wind Slash'' hits an enemy while ''Riven'' is not visible, it will briefly grant {{tip|sight}} of the area around her to enemies.<!--Radius? Perception bubble duration? Same as the 'upon targeting/attacking from Bush or Fog' one?-->
* If '''Riven''' has a basic attack buffered before the end of ''Wind Slash's'' cast time, the buffered basic attack will start {{fd|0.528}} seconds after the end of the cast time.
** The delay is not applied if a basic attack command is input after the cast time.
